extras: Celebration payment of £100 a year for occasions such as birthdays and religious festivals
Annual bonus of up to £1,000 a year, subject to criteria
Skills payment of £50 a week and disability payment of £75 a week where they apply
Up to two weeks of paid respite a year
Step-down payment of £150 a week and £50 per child for emergency placements
Referral reward of up to £2,500 through the Care Friends app
summary: Bracknell Forest publishes a single weekly figure per child that combines the child's allowance and the carer's professional fee, set for April 2026 to March 2027. Every carer starts on Tier 1, shown here; carers who complete further learning and development can move to Tier 2, which pays more, so check the Tier 2 rates with the council.
